title: The Latest Crier for Jan 28, 2026
items:
Central Black History Month Kickoff | Catered Lunch & Student-led Discussion | Please RSVP

Join us Tuesday, February 3 during common hour in the Maytag BMW rooms. The campus community is invited to attend the Black History Month Kickoff Lunch and Learn, a student-led continuation of the conversation sparked by the MLK Day keynote lecture, Moment of Impact: Race, Injury, and Memory in Iowa College Football, by Dr. Jaime Schultz. Lunch will be catered by Momma Moody’s Catering, a minority-owned business. Space is limited to the first 60 to RSVP here: https://forms.gle/ZNTbABRic6rzGBZU6

Casino Night is Back!

Join us on Friday, January 30th from 8-10 pm as we turn Maytag into a casino and give away hundreds of dollars in prizes! We'll have Texas Hold 'em poker, blackjack, bingo, and roulette. Worried that you'll get thirsty? Don't be, we're going to have a bar with amazing mocktails! The prize auction will follow at 10:15 pm so even if you don't win a lot of $$$ you can still win big!

GROCERY BINGO IS BACK!!!!!

Get ready for the most thrilling, edge of your seat, life changing event this semester... 
GROCERY BINGO 

Join CAB on Thursday, February 5th at 7pm in the Graham Conference Center, where YOU could be shouting "BINGO!" and walking away with groceries, laundry items, and HUGE prizes! 

Will you win snacks? Will you win detergent? Will you win bragging rights??? There's only one way to find out at Grocery Bingo!

Central Sounds Presents Winterlude: free live music concert and light show

Saturday, January 31 | 7:30-9:30pm | Douwstra Auditorium 
Come join Central Sounds for a live music concert with a light show provided by students from the Central College Musical Theatre Department. Doors open at 7pm. 

Featuring covers of: Olivia Dean, Harry Styles, ROLE MODEL, Rihanna, Paramore, Maroon 5, Olivia Rodrigo and more!

St. Mary's Catholic Church FREE shuttle bus to Sunday Mass

The Free shuttle bus to St. Mary's Catholic Church for Mass will run this Sunday 2/1/26. Pick-up will be on the west side of Central Market from 10:10 am to 10:15 am and at Independence and 3rd (4-way stop) from 10:16 am to 10:18 am. 
Pick-up times are carefully followed. Return drop-off will be at Central Market. No reservations are required. 

If you would like a weekly email with confirmation that the shuttle bus services will be provided that Sunday please email fullerj@central.edu.

Central College Wrestling on Iowa PBS

Get on your Central gear on, bring your rally towels and your Central Spirit to Kuyper Tuesday, February 3 at 7 p.m. to cheer on the Central men's wrestling team! 
Central College wrestling team set for appearance on Iowa PBS 

For the second year in a row, the Central College men's wrestling team's dual against Luther College will be featured on Iowa PBS's College Wrestling broadcast schedule The Dutch will host the Norse in Pella on Tuesday, February 3 at 7 p.m. Viewers can watch via livestream or YouTube . 

Let's pack the house!

Central College Mission Statement

Central College Mission Statement Central College is a welcoming learning community committed to vigorous and open inquiry as the best preparation for lives of integrity, creativity, and adaptability. Our students learn collaboratively with supportive educators who share a commitment to intellectual engagement, personal growth, career readiness and civic involvement. 

Shaped by its Christian heritage, Central College values inclusivity, humility, kindness, and hospitality, and invites learners of all backgrounds and faiths to join us in the pursuit of knowledge, opportunity, and fulfillment.

VOTE NOW for NEW Senate Seats!

There are 2 open seats for Senate this spring! Who should have them? 

VOTE NOW on Blackboard! Go to Organizations, Select "Student Senate Elections 25-26, Read through Candidate Profiles, VOTE for all whom you approve to represent you! 

Voting closes Friday the 30th at 5pm.

Annual Student Wellness & Fitness Fair with Top Shelf, Big Acai & More!

Win *Top Shelf Nutrition* for the Semester AND a Big Acai Prize Package worth $100! Stop by the Student Wellness & Fitness Fair - Tuesday, Jan. 27th 6:30-8:00 pm in Maytag. 

We will have 20+ campus services and community resources with special student offers, fun freebies, and great information to help you achieve your wellness goals and live your best life in 2026!

TRIO Upward Bound Tutor Counselor applications open!

"Don't take this job unless you want it to change your life" TRIO Upward Bound is looking to hire new Tutor Counselors for our summer program! TRIO UB is a federally funded college access program for income eligible/first gen students. TCs mentor our high school students, provide supervision, and impact lives. Applications are available in our office on the second floor of Geisler Library. Email Whitney at wagnerw@central.edu with questions. Applications are due February 20th.
